claims.text: Patient reports new dizziness after a lisinopril 20 mg morning dose, with home blood pressure 98/62 mmHg.

citations.quote: new dizziness after lisinopril 20 mg morning dose. Home blood pressure was 98/62 mmHg.

claims.text: The record contains a dose conflict for lisinopril: a staff note documents lisinopril 10 mg while another entry documents lisinopril 20 mg.

citations.quote: Patient started lisinopril 10 mg seven days ago.

claims.text: A staff note records that the medication list was reconciled and that the patient started lisinopril 10 mg seven days ago.

citations.quote: Medication list reconciled. Patient started lisinopril 10 mg seven days ago.
